manifest_metadata.title: Mirchi Rakshak Dataset Label Review Manifest
manifest_metadata.pipeline_stage: Dataset Quality Audit & Label Verification Workflow
manifest_metadata.safety_guardrail: NO AUTOMATIC RELABELING. All original files, splits, and checkpoints are preserved strictly in place.

data_collection_guidelines: Source high-resolution field images captured under natural sunlight with varied soil and background conditions.
Verify ChiLCV images with molecular PCR test or confirmed vector symptoms to prevent chlorosis cross-contamination.
Include early-stage, mid-stage, and late-stage viral infections.
Isolate pure Nitrogen chlorosis without co-occurring viral vector signs.
